brief_text: Use gravity 9.81 m/s2, contact friction 0.68, restitution 0.05, hinge damping 0.04 N m s/rad, and slide damping 0.20 N s/m; start every body from rest. Balls are 0.10 m diameter and 0.20 kg, dominoes are 0.08 by 0.04 by 0.24 m and 0.25 kg, carts are 0.22 by 0.18 by 0.10 m and 0.50 kg, blocks are 0.12 m cubes and 0.35 kg, ramps are 1.00 m long and 0.30 m wide at 20 degrees, and horizontal rings have 0.16 m clear diameter. Cart1 starts with its axial slide spring compressed 0.20 m; the spring stiffness is 18 N/m, and cart1 travels 0.50 m before touching ball1 at the high end of ramp1. Ball1 rolls down ramp1, whose low end is 0.15 m above the floor, crosses a 0.10 m gap, and touches the bob of pendulum1. Pendulum1, a 0.50 m long, 0.35 kg rigid pendulum, swings clockwise through 40 degrees and touches door1. Door1, a 0.42 by 0.32 by 0.04 m, 0.45 kg panel, swings clockwise through 70 degrees to its hard stop and knocks block1.
